title: A Render Alternative for Vibe-Coded Apps
linkedin:
Render is a clean PaaS.

The catch is structural. Every piece of your app (web service, worker, cron, database, cache) is its own billed service, and free instances spin down after about 15 minutes idle, so the next visitor waits through a cold start. The strongest Render alternative for a growing app isn't another PaaS.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/render-alternative-for-vibe-coded-apps/
